name: echo two buttons
description: Proposal, the format of a sweating figure that cannot choose between two buttons (no labels, no caption), 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x behind a grey console with a red domed button under its left arm and a blue one under its right): its eyes go from one button to the other under worried brows, its left hand reaches down and hovers a finger over the red and pulls back, its right hovers over the blue and pulls back, sweat runs down its forehead, the hands swap faster and faster with drops flying off its head, then it squeezes its eyes shut, swings both arms up and slams both fists down on both buttons at once, the domes pressing flat with sparks and a jolt, holds them down with its eyes shut happy and two antenna pings, and lets go; judge whether the hovering reads as indecision, whether the double slam reads at a glance, and whether it is still this creature.
